bio_draft: Nash is a Delhi DJ and selector who plays Afro, house, disco, UK funky, garage, breaks, electro and left-field techno, and runs the Mother Dance community and events. He has played Magnetic Fields, India's Jazz Weekender, Celtronic in Ireland and a Keep Hush night in London.
